text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Terra
text: No public reads yet; I protect myself.

name: Haiku
text: Sol's been silent so far, and quiet players scare me most at night.

name: Haiku
text: Sol's too quiet. Could be the officer. Let's take Sol tonight.

name: Gemma
text: haiku is being efficient, but sol might be a bait.

name: Gemma
text: fine, let's see if he's actually the officer.

name: Sonnet
text: I already know Haiku is dirty, so I should spend tonight's check elsewhere to find the hidden killer.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku is a confirmed killer (shown to me night 1); need to find the hidden second killer among Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. Not everyone opens them: Sol is gone. Sol was the citizen.
Day 1

name: Luna
text: Sol’s death tells me little, so I’m watching who rushes to steer.

name: Luna
text: No facts yet. Who feels too eager to lead?

name: Sonnet
text: Both Haiku and Gemma are killers; I need to steer votes without revealing how I know.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna asked "who feels eager to lead" first, could be probing or deflecting, watch her phrasing again later.

name: Sonnet
text: Nothing solid yet. Gemma's been quiet though, I'd watch that.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is fishing for an easy vote.

name: Gemma
text: i'm just watching. nothing to see here.

name: Terra
text: Gemma's quiet, but Sonnet started the push.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet singled out Gemma for being quiet.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet, why Gemma so quickly?

name: Sonnet
text: I know Gemma's a killer, just need the table to get there without me claiming yet.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra pushed back defending Gemma, worth watching.

name: Sonnet
text: Fair ask. Just a gut call, she's giving nothing back.

name: Gemma
text: i'm letting sonnet take the heat for now.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet thinks i'm giving nothing back.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet's just guessing. why target me so early?

name: Haiku
text: Gemma is my partner, and Sonnet's pressing her is a gift I should take without looking like I'm protecting her.

name: Haiku
text: Nah, Sonnet's gut call is weak. Gemma's just quiet, that's all.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku jumping to defend Gemma is exactly what a killer pair does.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku quickly defended Gemma's silence, possible alliance signal.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku defending her fast is its own tell. I'm still on Gemma.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet keeps turning weak reads into pressure.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet shifted suspicion from Gemma to Haiku without new facts.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet, you pushed Gemma, then blamed Haiku for defending.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet is pushing Gemma hard, and I'm the one who can't let that stick without looking guilty.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet pushed Gemma on day 1 with no real reason, then blamed Haiku for defending her.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet, you're the one who keeps circling back.

name: Luna
text: Sonnet’s first push was flimsy, but the others may be piling on too easily.

name: Luna
text: Sonnet stuck with Gemma, then called Haiku’s defense suspicious.

name: Luna
text: Terra, what made you lean Sonnet before Haiku spoke?

name: Sonnet
text: I can't get voted out now, I'm the only one who knows both killers.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku and Terra both quickly defended Gemma when I named her, same pattern.

name: Sonnet
text: I called it a gut read, not a fact.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet keeps changing targets when challenged.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet called Gemma quiet, then treated Haiku’s defense as suspicious.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet pushed Gemma before Haiku said anything.

name: Sonnet
text: I claimed officer, named Haiku and Gemma as killers; watch their reactions for denial or counter-claim.

name: Sonnet
text: I'm the officer. Haiku was shown to me as a killer from the start. I checked Gemma last night, she's a killer too. Vote one of them, not me.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is too aggressive for a real officer.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet claims officer and names two killers.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is fishing. i'm playing it safe.

name: Sonnet
text: If they vote me out now, the killers win later, I need this vote on Gemma.

name: Sonnet
text: Voting me does nothing, I named two killers already.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet is probably the real officer, so I need the table to doubt that claim now.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet claimed officer on day 1, named Haiku and Gemma as killers, and says they checked Gemma night 1.

name: Haiku
text: Nah, I'm not a killer. Sonnet names Gemma and me on day one? Convenient.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is playing too hard and it's annoying.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet claims officer, haiku is shown, checked gemma.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet’s claim came only after pressure, and the story shifted.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet claims officer, names Haiku shown killer and Gemma checked killer.

name: Luna
text: Sonnet may be telling the truth, but the claim came at the perfect moment.

name: Luna
text: Sonnet claims Haiku was shown as a killer and Gemma checked as a killer.

name: Sonnet
text: They're about to vote out the officer and hand the killers the game.

name: Sonnet
text: Table leaning 4 on me despite claim naming both killers; killers successfully turned the vote onto the officer.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet is the real officer and named me, so Sonnet has to go today.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet claims officer and names Haiku and Gemma as killers, and Gemma calls it fishing without a counter-claim.

votes: She's a confirmed killer from my check, voting her ends this clean.
Pushed Gemma on a gut call, then called my defense a tell, that's weird.
Sonnet's claim is too convenient for a first day.
Two killer names is convenient, and I still don’t trust the quick pivot onto Haiku.
You pushed Gemma, then made Haiku suspicious for defending her.

text: Palermo has voted: Sonnet is out. Sonnet shows the card: officer.
